blocks.text: Sahara dene wale (supporting) tissues podon ki banawat ko qaim rakhte hain, unhen sahara (support) dete hain aur lachak (flexibility) bhi dete hain. Yeh tissues parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma, xylem aur phloem hain.

Parenchyma tissue herbaceous podon (narm tane wale, ghair-lakri pode) aur bare podon ke kuch hisson ko sahara deta hai. Epidermis, cortex aur pith ke parenchyma cells pani jazb karte hain. Yeh pani cell ke andar ek dabao paida karta hai jise hydrostatic pressure ya turgor pressure kehte hain; yahi dabao cells ko sakht (rigid) rakhta hai.

Turgor pressure is liye banta hai ke cell ke vacuole ke andar osmotic pressure zyada hota hai. Vacuole ke gird jhilli (membrane) ko tonoplast kehte hain. Tonoplast mein active transport ke bohat se nizam hain jo ions ko vacuole ke andar dhakelte rehte hain, chahe andar ions pehle hi bahar ke mahlool (fluid) se zyada hon. Ions zyada hone ki wajah se pani vacuole mein khinch aata hai; cell turgid (phoola hua aur sakht) ho jata hai aur pode ke narm tissues ko mechanical sahara milta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Socho ek gubbara (balloon) jo dabbe ke andar phoola ho: andar ka dabao deewar ko dhakelta hai aur dabba sakht ho jata hai. Pani kam ho to cells dheele (flaccid) ho jate hain aur narm poda murjha (wilt) jata hai.

Collenchyma cells khaas cells hain jo dhaagon (strands) ya cylinders ki shakal mein ikatthe hote hain. Yeh naye tanon aur leaf stalks (patte ke danthal) ki epidermis ke neeche aur patton ki ragon (veins) ke saath milte hain. In mein secondary wall nahin hoti. In ki primary wall konon (corners) par cellulose zyada jamne se moti ho jati hai. Jab tana ya patta lambai mein barhta hai to yeh cells bhi lambe ho jate hain. Yeh pode ke un naye hisson ko sahara dete hain jin mein abhi secondary growth (motai mein barhna) nahin hui.

Yeh tissue bhi podon ko banawati sahara deta hai. Aam taur par sclerenchyma ke cells ki secondary cell walls moti hoti hain. In deewaron mein lignin bhara hota hai, jo ek organic compound hai aur deewar ko mazbooti aur sakhti deta hai. Zyada tar sclerenchyma cells murda (non-living) hote hain. Is tissue ka asal kaam pode ke mukhtalif hisson ko sahara dena hai. Sclerenchyma ke cells do qism ke hain: fibres aur sclereids.

Fibres lambe aur cylinder ki shakal ke hote hain. Yeh xylem ke andar ghane guchhon (compact bundles) ki soorat mein ya bundle caps (vascular bundle ke upar topi) ki soorat mein milte hain. Sclereids fibres se chhote hote hain aur beejon ke chhilkon (seed coats) aur nuts (akhrot, badaam waghaira) ke sakht khol mein hote hain; in ka kaam hifazat karna hai. Vessels lambi nali jaisi banawatein hain jo sira-ba-sira jur kar xylem mein pani le jane wali lambi pipe banati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab sclerenchyma ki teen qismein likhti hai: fibres, sclereids aur vessels, aur fibres ko “tracheids” kehti hai. Sahi yeh hai ke sclerenchyma ki do hi qismein hain: fibres aur sclereids. Tracheids aur vessels xylem ke pani le jane wale cells hain (topic 8.5), aur fibres tracheids nahin hote.

blocks.alt: (a) Parenchyma: gol cells jo aapas mein milte hain, har ek mein patli primary cell wall, cytoplasm, bara sap vacuole aur nucleus; labels Middle lamella, Intercellular space, Primary cell wall, Sap vacuole, Nucleus, Cytoplasm. (b) Collenchyma ka TS aur LS, moti pectin aur cellulose deewarein. (c) Sclerenchyma fibres: simple pits wala lamba fibre aur lignin wali deewaron ka TS. (d) Sclereids: lumen, lignified deewar, shakh-dar (branched) pits.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon ka farq deewar (cell wall) mein hai: parenchyma ki deewar patli hai aur cell zinda hai; collenchyma ki deewar konon (corners) par moti hai (pectin aur cellulose), is liye yeh lachakdar sahara deta hai; sclerenchyma ki deewar lignin se bohat moti hai aur cell aksar murda hota hai, beech mein sirf khali jagah (lumen) bachti hai. Pits deewar ki woh patli jagahein hain jin se saath wale cells ka rabta rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek chhota poda (seedling) pani milne par seedha khara rehta hai magar sookhne par jhuk jata hai, jab ke darakht ka tana kabhi nahin jhukta. Dono mein sahara dene wala tissue batayein aur farq samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Chhote pode ko parenchyma ka turgor pressure seedha rakhta hai: vacuole mein ions pani kheenchte hain aur pani ka dabao cells ko sakht rakhta hai. Pani kam ho to cells flaccid ho jate hain aur poda jhuk jata hai. Darakht ke tane ko sclerenchyma aur xylem sahara dete hain jin ki deewarein lignin se moti hain; yeh pani ho ya na ho, sakht rehti hain, is liye tana nahin jhukta.

items: Sahara dene wale tissues: parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma, xylem aur phloem.
Parenchyma turgor pressure se sahara deta hai: tonoplast ions vacuole mein bhejta hai, pani peeche aata hai aur cell sakht ho jata hai.

Collenchyma (zinda, konon par cellulose se moti deewar) naye hisson ko sahara deta hai. Sclerenchyma (lignin wali moti deewar, zyada tar murda) sakht sahara deta hai; is ki qismein fibres aur sclereids hain.
